generic.Defined scope/population: Billing accounts with an approved mid-term payment plan or schedule change request open in BillingCenter.
generic.In-scope period: Change requests received in the current billing cycle taking effect on or after the next unbilled instalment.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: New payment plan code, change effective date, mode-change fee and next due date are populated on the account.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Sum of remaining instalments equals unbilled written premium to the cent after the schedule rebuild.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Before and after instalment schedule previews are filed in the document repository with a timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Accounts left with orphaned instalment rows are logged with a correction owner and disposition.
generic.Test population: All mid-term billing mode changes applied in BillingCenter during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every changed account shows a rebuilt schedule equal to unbilled premium and zero orphan instalment rows.
generic.Exception handling path: Failed rebuilds are backed out and referred to the Billing Operations Manager before the notice run releases.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: New plan, effective date, filed fee and a regenerated premium notice are all present before release.
generic.Evidence location: BillingCenter account transaction history plus the change evidence pack in the document management repository.

steps.title: Open the billing account and record the current payment plan in BillingCenter
sop: Search BillingCenter by policy number and open the billing account named on the change request.
Record the current payment plan, next unbilled instalment due date and outstanding balance.
Confirm the signed or logged change request is attached to the account before editing.
Done when the current plan and next unbilled due date are recorded on the change case.
verify: Compare the recorded plan and due date against the BillingCenter account fields.
Pass when the recorded current plan and next unbilled due date match BillingCenter exactly.

steps.title: Validate the requested effective date against the instalment schedule in BillingCenter
sop: Compare the requested effective date to the next unbilled instalment due date on the schedule.
Move the effective date forward to the next unbilled due date if it would fall mid-instalment.
Confirm the revised effective date still sits inside the policy term.
Done when a compliant change effective date is agreed and recorded.
verify: Check the agreed effective date is on or after the next unbilled instalment due date.
Pass when no change is scheduled to take effect mid-instalment.

steps.title: Confirm the policy premium basis in the policy administration system
sop: Open the policy in the policy administration system and read the current written premium including endorsements.
Confirm the policy is in force and carries no pending transaction that would alter premium.
Pass the confirmed unbilled premium figure back to the billing change case.
Done when the unbilled premium basis is confirmed in writing on the case.
verify: Compare the confirmed premium basis to the BillingCenter account balance.
Pass when the policy premium basis and billing unbilled balance agree to the cent.

steps.title: Set the new payment plan on the billing account in BillingCenter
sop: Select the requested payment plan code on the billing account and enter the agreed effective date.
Leave already billed instalments untouched so prior notices remain valid.
Save the change and capture the transaction reference on the case.
Done when the account shows the new payment plan with the agreed effective date.
verify: Re-open the account and read the payment plan and effective date fields.
Pass when the account carries the requested plan code and the agreed effective date.

steps.title: Re-run the instalment schedule preview in BillingCenter
sop: Run the instalment schedule preview for the rebuilt plan.
Total the remaining instalments and compare to unbilled written premium.
List any instalment rows carried over from the superseded plan.
Done when the preview total equals unbilled written premium to the cent.
verify: Recompute the instalment total independently from the preview lines.
Pass when the totals agree to the cent and no superseded instalment row remains.

steps.title: Apply the state-filed mode-change or instalment fee in BillingCenter
sop: Look up the mode-change and instalment fee filed for the policy state and plan.
Add the fee as a separate charge type on the billing account.
Suppress the fee where the state or product does not permit it.
Done when the correct filed fee or a documented no-fee decision is on the account.
verify: Compare the applied fee to the filed fee schedule row for the policy state.
Pass when the fee charged equals the filed amount or a no-fee reason is recorded.

steps.title: Regenerate and inspect the next premium notice in BillingCenter
sop: Regenerate the next premium notice for the account after the schedule rebuild.
Confirm the notice shows the new instalment amount, due date and any fee.
Confirm the notice mailing date still meets the state advance-notice lead time.
Done when a correct regenerated notice is queued for the account.
verify: Read the regenerated notice against the rebuilt schedule line.
Pass when notice amount and due date match the first rebuilt instalment.

steps.title: Release the change and file the evidence pack in the document management repository
sop: Review the change case, the schedule preview pair and the fee decision.
Release the change so the notice run can pick up the account.
File the before and after previews and the request document in the repository.
Done when the change is released and the evidence pack is indexed by policy number.
verify: Retrieve the evidence pack from the repository using the policy number.
Pass when the pack is retrievable and shows a dated approval by the Billing Operations Manager.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every active state and line of business combination that produces premium notices from BillingCenter.
generic.In-scope period: The current statutory review cycle covering all bulletins and statute changes issued to date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each matrix row carries state, line, lead-time days and a current statute or bulletin citation.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Matrix row count equals the count of active state and line combinations in the policy book.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The advance-notice matrix version and the sample bill proofs are filed with review date and reviewer.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: States configured at the bare statutory minimum are logged and referred to compliance for a buffer decision.
generic.Test population: All configured advance-notice lead-time parameters across active state and line combinations.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No configured lead time is shorter than the statutory minimum for its state and line.
generic.Exception handling path: Short or missing lead times are corrected before the next notice run and escalated to compliance.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Every active state and line has a cited, configured lead time proven by a sample bill print date.
generic.Evidence location: BillingCenter notice configuration screens and the notice-timing evidence pack in the document repository.

steps.title: Extract the active state and line population from the policy administration system
sop: Extract in-force policy counts grouped by policy state and line of business.
Remove states and lines with no active policies and no new business appetite.
Publish the resulting active combination list to the notice-timing review.
Done when a dated list of active state and line combinations exists.
verify: Compare the combination count to the in-force extract control total.
Pass when every in-force policy maps to a combination on the list.

steps.title: Refresh the statutory advance-notice matrix with current citations
sop: Pull the current advance-notice requirement for each state and line from the statute or bulletin.
Record the required days before due date a bill must be mailed and the citation reference.
Update rows where a bulletin has changed the requirement since the last review.
Done when every row carries a lead time and a current citation.
verify: Spot-check citations for the highest volume states against the source text.
Pass when no matrix row lacks a statute or bulletin citation.

steps.title: Configure the lead-time parameter per state and line in BillingCenter
sop: Enter the required lead time against each state and line in the notice configuration.
Remove any single company-wide default that would override state values.
Save the configuration and record the change reference.
Done when each active combination has its own configured lead-time value.
verify: List configured parameters and compare to the matrix row by row.
Pass when every active combination has a parameter equal to or above its statutory minimum.

steps.title: Run a sample bill for the shortest lead-time state in BillingCenter
sop: Select the state and line with the shortest statutory lead time.
Generate a sample premium notice and read the print and mail date.
Compare the mail date to the due date less the statutory lead time.
Done when the sample proves the mail date meets the statutory minimum.
verify: Recompute the day count between mail date and due date on the sample.
Pass when the sample mail date is at or before the statutory latest mail date.

steps.title: Confirm mailing-date stamping is captured on the notice record in BillingCenter
sop: Open a released notice record and confirm the mail date field is populated from the print vendor file.
Confirm the stamped date is stored against the notice and not only in the batch log.
Test retrieval of proof of mailing for one policy end to end.
Done when proof of mailing can be produced for any released notice.
verify: Retrieve proof of mailing for a randomly chosen released notice.
Pass when the notice record returns a stamped mail date within the retrieval attempt.

steps.title: File the notice-timing evidence pack in the document management repository
sop: Assemble the matrix, the configuration listing and the sample bill proofs into one pack.
Index the pack by review date and version number.
Apply the retention class used for compliance evidence.
Done when the pack is filed and retrievable by review date.
verify: Retrieve the pack by review date from the repository.
Pass when the pack returns the matrix, configuration listing and sample proofs together.

steps.title: Escalate zero-buffer and short lead times to compliance
sop: List states where the configured lead time equals the statutory minimum with no buffer.
List any state where the configured value is below the minimum and correct it immediately.
Raise the zero-buffer list to compliance with a recommended buffer.
Done when every flagged state has a logged compliance referral or correction.
verify: Re-run the configuration comparison after corrections.
Pass when no configured lead time is below its statutory minimum and every zero-buffer state is referred.

generic.Defined scope/population: New and re-rated billing accounts in BillingCenter awaiting assignment of a billing cycle code.
generic.In-scope period: Policies bound in the current business day whose billing accounts are not yet cycle-assigned.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Billing cycle code, cycle anchor day, first due date and instalment count are populated on the account.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Generated instalment count equals the count implied by the elected payment plan and policy term.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The generated instalment schedule is retained on the account with a creation timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Accounts where the cycle pushes an instalment past expiration are logged and re-anchored.
generic.Test population: All billing accounts assigned a cycle during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No instalment is scheduled beyond policy expiration and every account carries a cycle code and anchor day.
generic.Exception handling path: Cycle conflicts are returned to the Policy Administration Analyst for confirmation of the elected plan.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Cycle code, anchor day and instalment count match the elected payment plan and the policy term.
generic.Evidence location: BillingCenter billing account schedule tab and the policy record in the policy administration system.

steps.title: Read the elected payment plan from the policy administration system
sop: Open the bound policy and read the elected payment plan and effective date.
Confirm the election is the current one and not superseded by a later endorsement.
Record the elected plan and effective date on the billing setup case.
Done when the elected plan and policy effective date are recorded.
verify: Compare the recorded plan to the policy declarations page.
Pass when the recorded plan matches the policy election exactly.

steps.title: Select the matching billing cycle code on the billing account in BillingCenter
sop: Open the billing account and select the cycle code matching the elected payment plan.
Reject any cycle code that does not exist in the approved cycle list.
Save the selection and note the transaction reference.
Done when the account carries the cycle code matching the elected plan.
verify: Read the cycle code back from the saved account.
Pass when the account cycle code corresponds to the elected payment plan.

steps.title: Set the cycle anchor day on the billing account in BillingCenter
sop: Set the anchor day so the first due date falls on or after the policy effective date.
Avoid anchor days above the twenty-eighth where short months would shift due dates.
Save the anchor day and regenerate the draft schedule.
Done when the first due date is on or after the policy effective date.
verify: Read the first due date from the regenerated schedule.
Pass when the first due date is not earlier than the policy effective date.

steps.title: Generate the instalment schedule and count the instalments in BillingCenter
sop: Generate the full instalment schedule for the policy term.
Count the instalments produced and compare to the count implied by the plan.
Investigate any difference before accepting the schedule.
Done when the generated instalment count matches the expected count.
verify: Recount instalments on the generated schedule.
Pass when the count equals the expected count for the plan and term.

steps.title: Check the final instalment against policy expiration in BillingCenter
sop: Read the due date of the last instalment on the generated schedule.
Compare it to the policy expiration date in the policy administration system.
Re-anchor the cycle if the final instalment falls after expiration.
Done when no instalment is dated after policy expiration.
verify: Compare the last instalment due date to the policy expiration date.
Pass when the last instalment due date is on or before expiration.

steps.title: Confirm the assigned cycle on the policy record in the policy administration system
sop: Confirm the policy record reflects the billing cycle assigned on the account.
Raise a correction where policy and billing disagree on the plan.
Record the confirmation on the billing setup case.
Done when policy and billing records show the same billing cycle.
verify: Compare the cycle shown on both systems.
Pass when the policy and billing records agree on cycle and plan.

steps.title: Release the cycle assignment for notice generation in BillingCenter
sop: Set the account to active so it is picked up by the notice generation job.
Confirm no validation error blocks the account from the next run.
Record the release timestamp on the setup case.
Done when the account is active and eligible for the next notice run.
verify: Run the notice eligibility check for the account.
Pass when the account appears eligible with no outstanding validation error.

generic.Defined scope/population: Policyholders electing EFT or card payment whose bank or card details must be captured for drafting.
generic.In-scope period: Enrolment requests received in the current business day ahead of the next draft run.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Payment token, last four digits, account type, account holder name and authorisation date are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of captured mandates equals the count of enrolment requests received and accepted for the day.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The dated debit authorisation is filed in the document repository against the billing account.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Failed routing checks, name mismatches and declined verifications are logged with the outcome.
generic.Test population: All bank and card capture events processed through the payment gateway in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No full account number or PAN is stored anywhere outside the gateway token.
generic.Exception handling path: Third-party payor name mismatches are held until a signed authorisation is filed.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: A token with last-four masking and a dated authorisation exists before any draft is scheduled.
generic.Evidence location: BillingCenter payment instrument record plus the authorisation image in the document repository.

steps.title: Launch the hosted capture page from the payment gateway
sop: Open the payment gateway hosted field from the billing account rather than a local form.
Confirm the session is bound to the correct billing account and policy number.
Do not transcribe account or card numbers into any note or case field.
Done when the hosted capture session is open against the correct account.
verify: Check the session reference against the billing account number.
Pass when the capture session is bound to the intended billing account.

steps.title: Capture routing and account details through the gateway hosted field
sop: Have the payor enter the routing number, account number and account type in the hosted field.
Let the gateway return only a token and the last four digits to BillingCenter.
Reject the capture if any full number is echoed back to the application.
Done when a token and last four digits are stored on the billing account.
verify: Read the stored payment instrument record on the account.
Pass when only a token and masked last four digits are present.

steps.title: Validate the ABA routing number and account type in BillingCenter
sop: Run the routing number check digit validation returned by the gateway.
Confirm the account type recorded is checking or savings as stated by the payor.
Reject and re-capture where the routing validation fails.
Done when routing validation passes and account type is recorded.
verify: Read the validation result stored against the instrument.
Pass when the routing check digit validated and account type is populated.

steps.title: Run a zero-dollar or one-dollar card verification in the payment gateway
sop: For card instruments submit a zero-dollar or one dollar verification to the gateway.
Record the authorisation code returned against the instrument.
Do not activate the mandate where the verification declines.
Done when a successful verification authorisation is recorded for the card.
verify: Read the verification result on the instrument record.
Pass when an approved verification exists before mandate activation.

steps.title: Match the account holder name to the payor of record in BillingCenter
sop: Compare the account holder name returned by the gateway to the payor of record.
Where the names differ obtain the third-party payor authorisation before proceeding.
File the authorisation in the document repository against the account.
Done when names match or a filed third-party authorisation exists.
verify: Check the payor name and any filed authorisation reference.
Pass when the holder matches the payor or an authorisation reference is present.

steps.title: Scan the billing case for prohibited full account images
sop: Review every attachment on the billing case for images showing full account or card numbers.
Remove or redact any attachment containing an unmasked number.
Record the review on the case with date and reviewer.
Done when no attachment on the case contains a full account or card number.
verify: Re-list case attachments after the review.
Pass when no attachment displays an unmasked account or card number.

steps.title: File the dated debit authorisation in the document management repository
sop: Store the signed or electronically assented authorisation with an authorisation identifier.
Index it by billing account number, policy number and authorisation date.
Link the identifier to the payment instrument record in BillingCenter.
Done when the authorisation is filed and linked to the instrument.
verify: Retrieve the authorisation from the repository using the billing account number.
Pass when the authorisation returns with a date and matches the stored instrument.

generic.Defined scope/population: Employer-sponsored and group cases requiring a list bill or payroll deduction billing arrangement.
generic.In-scope period: Group cases with an activation date falling in the current billing month.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Group account, remittance cycle, census file, billed lives and tolerance settings are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Billed lives and total premium tie to the group master policy schedule for the same period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The loaded census file version and the test list bill are retained against the group account.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Certificates that fail to link to the group account are logged with a resolution owner.
generic.Test population: All group billing arrangements activated in BillingCenter during the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No covered certificate remains on individual direct bill after group activation.
generic.Exception handling path: Short remittances suspend to the tolerance queue rather than auto-writing off.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Group account is live with all certificates linked and a remittance cycle matching payroll frequency.
generic.Evidence location: BillingCenter group account and the census and test bill files stored with the case in Microsoft Excel.

steps.title: Create the list bill or payroll deduction account in BillingCenter
sop: Create the group billing account keyed to the group master policy number.
Set the bill-to party to the employer or group administrator of record.
Record the account number on the group implementation case.
Done when a group billing account exists for the group master policy.
verify: Open the created account and read the bill-to party and master policy link.
Pass when the account is linked to the group master policy with the employer as bill-to.

steps.title: Link every covered certificate to the group account in the policy administration system
sop: List all covered certificates or policies under the group master policy.
Link each one to the single group billing account.
Remove individual direct bill accounts left behind by the transfer.
Done when every covered certificate points at the group billing account.
verify: Compare linked certificate count to the covered certificate count on the master schedule.
Pass when the counts agree and no certificate remains on individual direct bill.

steps.title: Set the group remittance cycle to the employer payroll frequency in BillingCenter
sop: Confirm the employer payroll frequency from the group agreement.
Set the remittance cycle to weekly, bi-weekly, semi-monthly or monthly to match.
Set the remittance due date offset agreed with the group administrator.
Done when the remittance cycle matches the stated payroll frequency.
verify: Compare the configured cycle to the payroll frequency in the group agreement.
Pass when the configured remittance cycle equals the payroll frequency.

steps.title: Load and reconcile the initial census in Microsoft Excel
sop: Load the initial census file and count billed lives and total premium.
Compare both figures to the group master policy schedule for the same period.
Investigate and clear every difference before the first bill.
Done when lives and premium on the census tie to the master schedule.
verify: Recompute census lives and premium totals independently.
Pass when census totals equal the master policy schedule totals.

steps.title: Configure under and overpayment tolerance on the group account in BillingCenter
sop: Set the tolerance band for short and over remittances against the group account.
Configure short remittances to suspend for research rather than auto-write-off.
Confirm overpayments route to the group suspense balance.
Done when tolerance settings suspend rather than write off variances.
verify: Simulate a short remittance against the configured tolerance.
Pass when the simulated short pay suspends and no write-off is generated.

steps.title: Issue a test list bill to the group administrator from BillingCenter
sop: Produce a test list bill in the agreed file layout for the group administrator.
Confirm member identifiers on the file match the employer payroll identifiers.
Obtain written confirmation that the layout is usable for their payroll system.
Done when the administrator confirms the test list bill is usable.
verify: Read the administrator confirmation filed on the group case.
Pass when a dated confirmation of layout and identifiers exists.

steps.title: Activate the group arrangement and record the go-live in BillingCenter
sop: Review the certificate linkage, census reconciliation and administrator confirmation.
Activate the group billing arrangement from the agreed effective date.
Record the activation date and approver on the group case.
Done when the arrangement is active with a recorded approval.
verify: Check the account status and the recorded approver on the case.
Pass when the account is active and carries a dated Billing Operations Manager approval.

generic.Defined scope/population: New business billing accounts awaiting activation confirmation from the policy administration team.
generic.In-scope period: Policies bound in the current business day and awaiting billing activation confirmation.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Policy status, policy number, written premium, effective date and contact name are recorded on the case.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Billing account premium equals the policy written premium to the cent at confirmation.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The activation confirmation is stored on the case with contact name and timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Premium or date mismatches are logged and held until the policy team corrects the source record.
generic.Test population: All new business billing cases confirmed for activation during the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every activated account carries a dated confirmation referencing an in-force policy number.
generic.Exception handling path: Accounts without a bound policy status are returned to the Policy Administration Analyst before activation.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Policy is bound, premium agrees and dates match before the billing account is activated.
generic.Evidence location: The new business billing case in the workflow tool plus the BillingCenter account audit trail.

steps.title: Open the new business billing case in the workflow tool
sop: Open the case for the new business policy awaiting billing activation.
Confirm the policy number and insured name on the case match the billing account.
Record the review start time on the case.
Done when the case is open and matched to the correct billing account.
verify: Compare the case policy number to the billing account policy link.
Pass when case and account reference the same policy number.

steps.title: Confirm the policy status is bound or in force in the policy administration system
sop: Open the policy and read the current status and effective date.
Confirm the status is bound or in force rather than quoted or pending.
Record the status and status date on the billing case.
Done when a bound or in-force status is recorded on the case.
verify: Re-read the policy status field after recording.
Pass when the policy status is bound or in force at the time of confirmation.

steps.title: Compare billing account premium to policy written premium in BillingCenter
sop: Read the total charges on the billing account and the written premium on the policy.
Compare the two figures to the cent and note any difference.
Hold activation where a difference exists and raise it to the policy team.
Done when the two premium figures agree or a hold is recorded.
verify: Recompute the difference between billing charges and written premium.
Pass when the difference is zero at the point of activation.

steps.title: Match the policy effective date to the billing account start date in BillingCenter
sop: Read the policy effective date and the billing account start date.
Correct the billing account start date where it does not match the policy.
Record the matched dates on the case.
Done when the account start date equals the policy effective date.
verify: Compare the two dates after correction.
Pass when the billing start date equals the policy effective date.

steps.title: Record the policy team confirmation on the billing case
sop: Provide written confirmation that the policy is in force and premium is final.
Include the confirming contact name and the confirmation timestamp.
Attach any supporting policy screenshot reference to the case.
Done when a named, timestamped confirmation is on the case.
verify: Read the confirmation entry on the case.
Pass when the entry shows a contact name and a timestamp.

steps.title: Activate the billing account in BillingCenter
sop: Set the billing account to active once status, premium and dates agree.
Confirm the account becomes eligible for the next notice generation run.
Record the activation transaction reference on the case.
Done when the account is active with a recorded transaction reference.
verify: Read the account status and activation transaction.
Pass when the account is active and the activation is logged in the audit trail.

steps.title: Close the activation case in the workflow tool
sop: Attach the confirmation, premium comparison and activation reference to the case.
Set the case outcome to activated and close it.
Route any unresolved mismatch to a follow-up case instead of closing.
Done when the case is closed with all three evidence items attached.
verify: Reopen the closed case and list attachments.
Pass when confirmation, premium comparison and activation reference are all present.

generic.Defined scope/population: Released premium notices for the billing window split across paper, email and portal delivery channels.
generic.In-scope period: The current notice release window covering all due dates in that billing cycle.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each notice record carries a delivery channel, address or email, and a delivery acknowledgement field.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Print vendor return file count and dollar total match the released notice batch control totals.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Channel split file, vendor return file and portal posting log are retained with the release timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Bounced e-deliveries are logged and re-queued to paper with the re-queue date recorded.
generic.Test population: All notices released for distribution in the billing window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No policy appears in more than one delivery channel for the same billing cycle.
generic.Exception handling path: Bounce-backs and vendor rejects are re-queued within the statutory notice lead time.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Every released notice has one channel and a vendor or portal delivery acknowledgement.
generic.Evidence location: BillingCenter notice records, the vendor return file and the self-service portal statement log.

steps.title: Split the notice extract by delivery preference in BillingCenter
sop: Extract the released notice population for the billing window.
Split it into paper, email and portal-only sets using the delivery preference of record.
Check no policy appears in two sets and no policy is missing from all three.
Done when the three channel sets together equal the released population exactly.
verify: Sum the three channel counts and compare to the released notice count.
Pass when the sum equals the released count with no policy in two channels.

steps.title: Exclude suppressed accounts from the distribution in BillingCenter
sop: List accounts that are lapsed, flat cancelled or paid in full for the window.
Remove those accounts from all three channel sets.
Record the suppression count and reason on the release case.
Done when no suppressed account remains in any channel set.
verify: Re-scan the channel sets for suppressed account statuses.
Pass when no lapsed, cancelled or paid-in-full account is present.

steps.title: Transmit the paper set to the print vendor from BillingCenter
sop: Transmit the paper channel file with its record count and dollar control total.
Record the transmission reference and time on the release case.
Confirm the vendor acknowledges receipt of the file.
Done when the vendor acknowledges the transmitted paper file.
verify: Compare the acknowledged record count to the transmitted count.
Pass when the vendor acknowledgement matches the transmitted control totals.

steps.title: Reconcile the print vendor return file to the released batch
sop: Load the vendor return file and read the processed count and dollar total.
Compare both against the released paper batch control totals.
List and chase any record the vendor did not process.
Done when vendor counts and dollars equal the released paper batch.
verify: Recompute the vendor to batch difference.
Pass when the difference is zero or every gap item is logged and chased.

steps.title: Confirm portal statements are posted in the Customer Self-Service Portal
sop: Check that portal-only policies show a posted statement on the release date.
Sample several accounts and open the posted statement.
Re-post any statement missing from the portal on the release date.
Done when every portal-only policy has a posted statement dated the release date.
verify: Query the portal statement log for the release date.
Pass when portal statement count equals the portal-only policy count.

steps.title: Work e-delivery bounce-backs and re-queue to paper in BillingCenter
sop: Load the email bounce report for the release.
Re-queue each bounced policy to paper delivery for the same cycle.
Confirm the re-queue still meets the statutory notice lead time.
Done when every bounce is re-queued to paper inside the lead time.
verify: Compare the bounce count to the paper re-queue count.
Pass when every bounced policy has a paper re-queue inside the lead time.

steps.title: Sign off the distribution and file the evidence in the document management repository
sop: Review channel split totals, the vendor reconciliation and the bounce re-queue log.
Sign off the distribution as complete for the billing window.
File the channel split, vendor return and portal log as one evidence pack.
Done when the distribution is signed off and the pack is filed.
verify: Retrieve the evidence pack by billing window from the repository.
Pass when the pack is retrievable and shows a dated manager sign-off.

generic.Defined scope/population: Bound policies with no billing account, requiring account, plan and payment schedule setup in BillingCenter.
generic.In-scope period: Policies bound in the current business day and awaiting billing account creation.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Account holder name, mailing address, payment plan, first due date, instalment count and legal entity are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Opening account balance equals the policy written premium with zero prior transactions.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The created account record and the generated schedule are retained with a creation timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Duplicate account hits and address mismatches are logged with the resolution taken.
generic.Test population: All billing accounts created for newly bound policies during the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No duplicate active billing account exists for the same policy number.
generic.Exception handling path: Duplicate hits are routed to the Policy Administration Analyst before either account is used.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Account is linked to the bound policy with a plan, first due date and opening balance equal to written premium.
generic.Evidence location: BillingCenter account creation audit trail and the policy record in the policy administration system.

steps.title: Run a duplicate account search in BillingCenter
sop: Search BillingCenter on policy number, insured name and mailing address.
List any existing active account that could duplicate the new one.
Resolve or merge duplicates before creating a new account.
Done when the search returns no existing active account for the policy.
verify: Repeat the duplicate search after creation.
Pass when exactly one active billing account exists for the policy number.

steps.title: Create the billing account keyed to the policy number in BillingCenter
sop: Create the account and link it to the bound policy number.
Enter the account holder name and mailing address from the policy declarations.
Save and record the new account number on the setup case.
Done when a billing account exists linked to the bound policy.
verify: Compare account holder name and address to the declarations page.
Pass when name and address match the policy declarations exactly.

steps.title: Confirm currency, billing entity and legal entity code in BillingCenter
sop: Read the writing company from the policy record.
Set the billing entity and legal entity code on the account to match.
Confirm the account currency matches the policy currency.
Done when entity codes and currency match the writing company.
verify: Compare the account entity codes to the policy writing company.
Pass when the entity code and currency agree with the policy.

steps.title: Set the payment plan, first due date and instalment count in BillingCenter
sop: Enter the elected payment plan from the policy record.
Set the first due date on or after the policy effective date.
Confirm the instalment count matches the plan and policy term.
Done when plan, first due date and instalment count are set on the account.
verify: Read the schedule header after generation.
Pass when plan, first due date and instalment count match the election.

steps.title: Confirm the elected plan against the policy record in the policy administration system
sop: Open the policy and confirm the payment plan recorded on the billing account.
Flag any discrepancy between the policy election and the billing plan.
Record the confirmation on the billing setup case.
Done when the policy team confirms the billing plan matches the election.
verify: Compare the confirmed plan to the account payment plan field.
Pass when both records show the same elected payment plan.

steps.title: Confirm the opening balance equals written premium in BillingCenter
sop: Read the opening account balance after schedule generation.
Compare it to the policy written premium including taxes and fees.
Confirm no prior transaction exists on the new account.
Done when the opening balance equals written premium with no prior transactions.
verify: Recompute the opening balance from the generated instalment lines.
Pass when the balance equals written premium and the transaction list is empty.

steps.title: Release the account for notice generation in BillingCenter
sop: Set the account status to active for billing.
Confirm it passes the notice generation eligibility validation.
Record the release timestamp and reference on the setup case.
Done when the account is active and eligible for the next notice run.
verify: Run the eligibility check for the account.
Pass when the account is eligible with no blocking validation error.

generic.Defined scope/population: First-bill data records generated in BillingCenter for newly activated billing accounts awaiting notice production.
generic.In-scope period: Accounts activated in the current billing window with a first instalment not yet billed.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Policy number, insured name, due date, instalment amount, total premium and remittance reference are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Record total equals the first instalment amount on the billing account schedule.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The generated first-bill record and its itemised lines are retained with a generation timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Records with null due dates, zero amounts or missing addresses are logged and reworked before release.
generic.Test population: All first-bill data records generated in the billing window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No first-bill record is released with a null due date or a zero premium amount.
generic.Exception handling path: Rejected records are corrected in BillingCenter and regenerated rather than manually patched.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Record shows policy number, due date, itemised premium lines and a remittance reference before release.
generic.Evidence location: BillingCenter first-bill record and the archived record image in the document management repository.

steps.title: Select activated accounts awaiting a first bill in BillingCenter
sop: Query accounts activated in the window with no first-bill record generated.
Exclude accounts already billed or suppressed for the window.
Record the selected population count on the run case.
Done when the first-bill selection population is fixed and counted.
verify: Compare the selection count to the activated account count for the window.
Pass when every activated unbilled account appears in the selection.

steps.title: Generate the first-bill data record in BillingCenter
sop: Run the first-bill generation job for the selected population.
Confirm each record carries policy number, insured name, due date, instalment amount and total premium.
Capture the run identifier and generation timestamp.
Done when a first-bill record exists for every selected account.
verify: Compare generated record count to the selected population count.
Pass when the counts agree with no unexplained shortfall.

steps.title: Check itemisation of taxes and surcharges on the record in BillingCenter
sop: Open sample records and read the premium line breakdown.
Confirm taxes, surcharges and separately disclosed items appear as distinct lines.
Reject any record folding these amounts into base premium.
Done when disclosed items appear as separate lines on the record.
verify: Sum the itemised lines and compare to the record total.
Pass when itemised lines sum to the total with disclosed items shown separately.

steps.title: Reconcile the record total to the first instalment in BillingCenter
sop: Read the first instalment amount from the billing account schedule.
Compare it to the total on the generated first-bill record.
Investigate and correct any difference before release.
Done when the record total equals the first instalment amount.
verify: Recompute the difference between record total and instalment amount.
Pass when the difference is zero for every record.

steps.title: Confirm the remittance address and payment reference on the record
sop: Confirm the remittance address matches the current lockbox address of record.
Confirm the payment reference is the value cash application keys on.
Correct any stale remittance detail before release.
Done when remittance address and payment reference are current on every record.
verify: Compare the remittance block to the current lockbox configuration.
Pass when address and reference match the current lockbox configuration.

steps.title: Reject and rework defective records in BillingCenter
sop: List records with a null due date, zero amount or missing mailing address.
Correct the underlying account data and regenerate those records.
Log each rejected record with its defect and the correction applied.
Done when no defective record remains in the release set.
verify: Re-scan the release set for null dates, zero amounts and missing addresses.
Pass when the scan returns no defective record.

steps.title: Release the first-bill records and archive them in the document management repository
sop: Release the validated first-bill records for notice production.
Archive the record images indexed by policy number and due date.
Record the release timestamp and run identifier on the case.
Done when records are released and archived with an index.
verify: Retrieve an archived record by policy number.
Pass when the archived record returns and matches the released version.

generic.Defined scope/population: In-force policies with an instalment due in the notice window selected by the BillingCenter notice job.
generic.In-scope period: The due-date window covered by the current premium notice generation run.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each notice shows prior balance, current charges, payments applied, amount due and due date.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Batch premium total ties to the billing ledger instalments due for the same window.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The batch control report and exception report are retained with the run timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Every failed notice is logged with a reprocess outcome before the mailing deadline.
generic.Test population: All premium notices generated in the notice run for the due-date window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No notice is produced for a policy already cancelled flat or paid in full.
generic.Exception handling path: Failed notices are reprocessed and re-reconciled before the statutory mailing deadline.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Batch is reconciled, suppressions applied and exceptions cleared before release to print.
generic.Evidence location: BillingCenter notice batch control report and the archived notice images in the document repository.

steps.title: Run the notice generation job for the due-date window in BillingCenter
sop: Set the due-date window parameters and run the notice generation job.
Capture the selected policy count and the batch identifier.
Compare the selected count to the expected in-force cohort for the window.
Done when the batch is generated and the selected count is recorded.
verify: Compare the selected policy count to the expected in-force cohort.
Pass when the counts agree within the documented tolerance.

steps.title: Reconcile the batch premium total to the billing ledger in BillingCenter
sop: Extract instalments due for the window from the billing ledger.
Compare the ledger total to the notice batch premium total.
Investigate every difference before releasing to print.
Done when the batch total equals the ledger instalments due.
verify: Recompute the batch to ledger difference.
Pass when the difference is zero or fully explained in writing.

steps.title: Check notice content shows balance, charges and payments in BillingCenter
sop: Open a sample of notices across products and billing modes.
Confirm each shows prior balance, current charges, payments applied and amount now due.
Reject templates missing any of these elements.
Done when sampled notices show all four content elements.
verify: Recompute amount due from the displayed components on each sample.
Pass when displayed amount due equals prior balance plus charges less payments.

steps.title: Apply suppression rules for paid, cancelled and lapsing accounts in BillingCenter
sop: Identify policies paid in full, cancelled flat or in active lapse processing.
Remove those policies from the notice batch.
Record the suppressed count and reason on the run case.
Done when no suppressed policy remains in the batch.
verify: Re-scan the batch for suppressed statuses.
Pass when no cancelled flat or paid-in-full policy remains in the batch.

steps.title: Work the batch exception report in BillingCenter
sop: Open the batch exception report and list every failed notice.
Correct the underlying data and reprocess each failure.
Confirm all reprocessing completes before the statutory mailing deadline.
Done when the exception report shows zero unresolved failures.
verify: Re-run the exception report after reprocessing.
Pass when no failed notice remains open at the mailing deadline.

steps.title: Archive the produced notice images in the document management repository
sop: Archive the produced notice images indexed by policy number and notice date.
Apply the retention class used for premium notices.
Confirm retrieval of a sample notice by policy number.
Done when notices are archived and retrievable by policy number.
verify: Retrieve a sampled notice image from the repository.
Pass when the archived image matches the released notice.

steps.title: Approve the batch for release in BillingCenter
sop: Review the reconciliation, suppression list and cleared exception report.
Approve the batch for release to print and e-delivery.
Record the approval name and timestamp against the batch.
Done when the batch carries a dated release approval.
verify: Read the approval record on the batch.
Pass when the batch shows a named approval dated before release.

generic.Defined scope/population: All billing setup and maintenance transactions posted to billing accounts in BillingCenter.
generic.In-scope period: Setup transactions posted during the current audit review period.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each audit entry holds user ID, timestamp, field changed, old value and new value.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Audit entry count equals the count of setup transactions posted in the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Audit extracts are retained with the extraction timestamp and the source request document link.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Changes attributed to shared or generic accounts are logged and referred for access remediation.
generic.Test population: All billing setup changes recorded in the BillingCenter audit trail for the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No billing setup change is attributed to a shared or generic account.
generic.Exception handling path: Missing audit entries are escalated to the Billing Operations Manager as a control failure.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Every setup change shows before and after values against a named user ID.
generic.Evidence location: BillingCenter audit trail extract and the linked request documents in the document repository.

steps.title: Extract billing setup transactions for the period from BillingCenter
sop: Extract all setup and maintenance transactions posted in the review period.
Include payment plan, bank detail, payor and address changes.
Record the extract control count on the review case.
Done when the transaction extract exists with a control count.
verify: Compare the extract count to the BillingCenter transaction report total.
Pass when both counts agree for the period.

steps.title: Extract the matching audit entries from BillingCenter
sop: Extract audit trail entries for the same period and transaction types.
Match each transaction to its audit entry by transaction reference.
List transactions with no matching audit entry.
Done when every transaction is matched or listed as unmatched.
verify: Compare audit entry count to transaction count.
Pass when the counts agree and the unmatched list is empty.

steps.title: Check before and after values on each audit entry in BillingCenter
sop: Open sampled audit entries across change types.
Confirm each shows field changed, old value, new value, user ID and timestamp.
Flag entries missing any of the five attributes.
Done when sampled entries carry all five attributes.
verify: Recheck the flagged entries after remediation.
Pass when every sampled entry shows all five attributes.

steps.title: Confirm plan and bank changes are logged as separate events in BillingCenter
sop: Select accounts where plan and bank details changed on the same day.
Confirm each change produced its own auditable event.
Flag any single bulk update covering several field changes.
Done when plan and bank changes appear as separate audit events.
verify: Count audit events for the selected accounts.
Pass when the event count equals the number of distinct field changes.

steps.title: Link audit entries to source request documents in the document management repository
sop: For each sampled change locate the source request document in the repository.
Record the document reference against the audit entry.
Raise a case where no source document exists for a change.
Done when every sampled change links to a source document or an exception case.
verify: Retrieve the linked document for each sampled entry.
Pass when each sampled change resolves to a retrievable source document.

steps.title: Test that audit records are immutable to the setup user in BillingCenter
sop: Attempt to edit and delete a test audit entry using a standard setup user profile.
Record the system response for both attempts.
Escalate to access management if either attempt succeeds.
Done when both attempts are recorded as blocked or escalated.
verify: Read the recorded system responses for the two attempts.
Pass when the setup user can neither edit nor delete an audit entry.

steps.title: Report generic account attribution to access management
sop: Filter audit entries for shared, generic or service account user IDs.
List each affected change with account and date.
Refer the list to access management with a remediation request.
Done when every generic attribution is listed and referred.
verify: Re-run the generic account filter after referral.
Pass when no new setup change is attributed to a generic account.

generic.Defined scope/population: The policy in-force file and the billing account master extracted as at the same close date.
generic.In-scope period: The reconciliation close date covering all policies in force at that date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Policy number, status, written premium, billing account number and scheduled instalment total are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Matched policy count plus unmatched items equals the total in-force and billing record counts.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The reconciliation workbook is saved with the close date and both extract timestamps.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Each break is logged with root cause, owner and target clearance date.
generic.Test population: All policies on the in-force file and all accounts on the billing master for the close date.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No in-force policy is missing a corresponding active billing account after clearance.
generic.Exception handling path: Unbilled exposure items are escalated to the Billing Operations Manager for same-week clearance.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: A matched population plus an itemised break list with named owners exists for the close date.
generic.Evidence location: The reconciliation workbook in Microsoft Excel filed with the period close evidence.

steps.title: Extract the policy in-force file from the policy administration system
sop: Extract in-force policies as at the reconciliation close date.
Include policy number, status, written premium and effective dates.
Record the extract row count and timestamp.
Done when the in-force extract exists with a recorded control count.
verify: Compare the extract count to the in-force policy count report.
Pass when both counts agree for the close date.

steps.title: Extract the billing account master from BillingCenter
sop: Extract billing accounts as at the same close date.
Include account number, policy link, status and scheduled instalment total.
Record the extract row count and timestamp.
Done when the billing extract exists for the same close date.
verify: Compare the billing extract date to the in-force extract date.
Pass when both extracts share the same close date and timestamps are recorded.

steps.title: Match the two extracts on policy number in Microsoft Excel
sop: Join the in-force and billing extracts on policy number.
Produce the matched population and both unmatched lists.
Confirm the three groups sum back to the source counts.
Done when matched and unmatched populations reconcile to both extracts.
verify: Sum matched and unmatched counts against the source extract counts.
Pass when the sums equal both source extract counts.

steps.title: List unbilled exposure and billing orphans in Microsoft Excel
sop: List in-force policies with no billing account as unbilled exposure.
List billing accounts with no in-force policy as billing orphans.
Quantify premium at risk on each list.
Done when both lists exist with premium quantified.
verify: Recount the two lists against the unmatched populations.
Pass when the lists together equal the unmatched populations.

steps.title: Compare written premium to scheduled instalments in Microsoft Excel
sop: For matched policies compare written premium to total scheduled instalments.
List variances above the materiality threshold.
Note endorsement timing as a candidate cause on each variance.
Done when a variance list above the threshold exists.
verify: Recompute a sample of variances from the source values.
Pass when recomputed variances agree with the listed values.

steps.title: Check cancelled and reinstated policies carry matching billing status in BillingCenter
sop: List policies cancelled or reinstated during the period.
Compare each policy status to the billing account status.
Add any mismatch to the break list.
Done when every cancelled or reinstated policy has a status comparison.
verify: Re-check the status pairs after correction.
Pass when policy and billing statuses agree for the whole list.

steps.title: Log breaks with owners and clearance dates in the reconciliation workbook
sop: Record every break with root cause, owner and target clearance date.
Assign unbilled exposure items the shortest clearance target.
Circulate the break list to the assigned owners.
Done when every break has a root cause, owner and clearance date.
verify: Scan the break list for missing owners or dates.
Pass when no break row lacks a root cause, owner or clearance date.

steps.title: Review and sign off the reconciliation
sop: Review the matched population, break list and premium variances.
Challenge any break without a credible root cause.
Sign off the reconciliation and file it with the close evidence.
Done when the reconciliation carries a dated sign-off.
verify: Read the sign-off block on the filed workbook.
Pass when the workbook shows a dated Billing Operations Manager sign-off.

generic.Defined scope/population: Billing accounts where a lienholder or third-party payor is to receive the premium notice.
generic.In-scope period: Redirect requests effective from the next unbilled instalment in the current cycle.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Bill-to party, payor address, authorisation reference and redirect effective date are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of redirected accounts equals the count of filed authorisations for the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The signed request or lienholder clause is filed with a date and document reference.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Redirect requests without authority evidence are logged and held pending documentation.
generic.Test population: All third-party billing redirects applied in BillingCenter during the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No third-party redirect exists without an authorisation document on file.
generic.Exception handling path: Unsupported redirects are reversed and the request returned to the requester.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Bill-to party is the third party, authorisation is filed and the insured copy rule is applied.
generic.Evidence location: BillingCenter bill-to configuration and the authorisation document in the document repository.

steps.title: Obtain and file the authority evidence in the document management repository
sop: Obtain the signed request or the lienholder clause evidencing authority to bill the third party.
File it in the repository indexed by policy number and payor name.
Record the document reference on the billing account.
Done when authority evidence is filed and referenced on the account.
verify: Retrieve the authority document using the policy number.
Pass when the document returns and names the intended third-party payor.

steps.title: Confirm the lienholder interest on the policy in the policy administration system
sop: Open the policy and read the lienholder or additional interest record.
Confirm the named payor matches the interest recorded on the policy.
Record the confirmation on the redirect case.
Done when the payor is confirmed against the policy interest record.
verify: Compare the payor name to the policy additional interest record.
Pass when the payor matches an interest recorded on the policy.

steps.title: Set the bill-to party on the billing account in BillingCenter
sop: Change the bill-to party to the lienholder or third-party payor.
Enter the payor address exactly as shown on the authorisation document.
Save and capture the transaction reference.
Done when the account bill-to party is the third-party payor.
verify: Compare the saved payor address to the authorisation document.
Pass when the account address matches the authorisation exactly.

steps.title: Keep the insured on notice distribution where required in BillingCenter
sop: Check the state rule on courtesy copies to the named insured.
Add the insured as a courtesy copy recipient where required.
Record the rule applied on the redirect case.
Done when the insured copy setting matches the state rule.
verify: Read the notice recipient list on the account.
Pass when the recipient list matches the state courtesy copy rule.

steps.title: Set the redirect to take effect from the next unbilled instalment in BillingCenter
sop: Set the redirect effective date to the next unbilled instalment due date.
Confirm no already-mailed notice will be duplicated to the new payor.
Record the effective date on the case.
Done when the redirect starts at the next unbilled instalment.
verify: Compare the redirect effective date to the last mailed notice date.
Pass when no already-mailed instalment is re-issued to the new payor.

steps.title: Suppress privacy-sensitive fields on the third-party copy in BillingCenter
sop: Review the third-party notice template for privacy-sensitive fields.
Apply the suppression rule so restricted data is not shown to the payor.
Produce a proof copy and read it against the suppression rule.
Done when the third-party proof shows no suppressed field.
verify: Inspect the proof copy for suppressed fields.
Pass when no privacy-sensitive field appears on the third-party copy.

steps.title: Confirm the redirect on the next generated notice in BillingCenter
sop: Generate the next premium notice for the account.
Confirm it addresses the third-party payor and reflects the courtesy copy rule.
Attach the proof to the redirect case and close it.
Done when the next notice is addressed to the third-party payor.
verify: Read the addressee block on the generated notice.
Pass when the notice is addressed to the authorised third-party payor.

generic.Defined scope/population: New business policies bound in the period and the billing accounts activated against them.
generic.In-scope period: The reporting period agreed with finance and operations, typically the prior calendar month.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Bound count, activated count, activation gap by day, product line and billing mode are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Activated premium in the report equals billing ledger new business premium for the same period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The report and its source extracts are retained with the run date and data-as-at timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Accounts past the activation SLA are listed with an owner and expected activation date.
generic.Test population: All new business policies bound in the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Reported activated premium reconciles to the billing ledger with no unexplained difference.
generic.Exception handling path: Unreconciled differences are investigated before distribution rather than footnoted.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Report shows bound versus activated counts, SLA breaches and a ledger reconciliation.
generic.Evidence location: The BI reporting platform report definition and the extract retained in the enterprise data warehouse.

steps.title: Extract bound policies and activated accounts from the enterprise data warehouse
sop: Extract new business policies bound in the period from the warehouse.
Extract billing accounts activated in the same period.
Record both control counts and the data-as-at timestamp.
Done when both extracts exist for the same period with control counts.
verify: Compare warehouse counts to the BillingCenter source counts.
Pass when warehouse and source counts agree within the documented tolerance.

steps.title: Build the bound versus activated gap by day in the BI reporting platform
sop: Join bound policies to activated accounts on policy number.
Report the daily gap between bound and activated counts.
List policies bound but not yet activated with days elapsed.
Done when the daily gap and the outstanding list are produced.
verify: Sum the daily gaps and compare to the outstanding list count.
Pass when the totals agree for the period.

steps.title: Report first-notice issuance rate and SLA breaches in the BI reporting platform
sop: Calculate the share of activated accounts with a first notice issued.
List accounts still awaiting activation past the SLA with days overdue.
Assign an owner to each overdue account.
Done when issuance rate and the SLA breach list are produced.
verify: Recompute the issuance rate from the underlying counts.
Pass when the recomputed rate matches the reported rate.

steps.title: Break the cohort down by product line and billing mode in the BI reporting platform
sop: Split bound and activated counts by product line and billing mode.
Show EFT take-up as a share of activated accounts.
Confirm the splits sum back to the period totals.
Done when the breakdown sums to the period totals.
verify: Sum the breakdown rows against the period totals.
Pass when the breakdown reconciles exactly to the totals.

steps.title: Reconcile activated premium to the billing ledger
sop: Extract new business premium from the billing ledger for the period.
Compare it to activated premium in the report.
Explain every difference before the report is distributed.
Done when the report premium ties to the ledger or differences are explained.
verify: Recompute the report to ledger difference.
Pass when the difference is zero or documented with a cause.

steps.title: Review the report and call out exceptions
sop: Review the gap analysis, SLA breach list and ledger reconciliation.
Add commentary on adverse trends and named remediation owners.
Approve the report for distribution.
Done when the report carries commentary and an approval.
verify: Read the approval and commentary block on the report.
Pass when the report shows a dated manager approval and exception commentary.

steps.title: Distribute the report to finance and operations leadership
sop: Distribute the approved report by the agreed working-day deadline.
Send to the finance and operations distribution list of record.
Log the distribution date and recipient list.
Done when the report is distributed on or before the deadline.
verify: Compare the distribution date to the agreed deadline.
Pass when distribution occurred on or before the agreed working day.

generic.Defined scope/population: Policyholders electing EFT drafting who require an active NACHA-compliant debit authorisation.
generic.In-scope period: Authorisations established ahead of the next scheduled draft run.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Authorisation ID, debit amount basis, frequency, start date and revocation path are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of active mandates equals the count of retrievable stored authorisations.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The signed or assented authorisation is stored with a date and authorisation identifier.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Failed validations and returned pre-notifications are logged with the corrective action.
generic.Test population: All EFT mandates activated in BillingCenter during the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No live draft schedule exists without a retrievable signed or assented authorisation.
generic.Exception handling path: Validation failures suspend the mandate until the payor supplies corrected details.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Mandate shows an authorisation ID, disclosed amount and frequency, and a clean account validation.
generic.Evidence location: BillingCenter mandate record and the authorisation image in the document management repository.

steps.title: Capture the ACH debit authorisation and store it with an ID
sop: Capture the signed or electronically assented ACH debit authorisation.
Store it in the document repository with a unique authorisation identifier.
Record the authorisation ID on the billing account mandate.
Done when the authorisation is stored and its ID is on the mandate.
verify: Retrieve the authorisation using the ID on the mandate.
Pass when the stored authorisation returns and matches the payor of record.

steps.title: Check the authorisation discloses amount, frequency and start date
sop: Read the authorisation text for the debit amount or its calculation basis.
Confirm the frequency and effective start date are stated.
Reject and re-obtain any authorisation missing a required disclosure.
Done when all three disclosures are present on the authorisation.
verify: Re-read the stored authorisation for the three disclosures.
Pass when amount basis, frequency and start date are all stated.

steps.title: Run a pre-notification or account validation through the Payment Gateway
sop: Submit a pre-notification or account validation for the payor account.
Wait the required window and read the response for any return code.
Suspend the mandate where any R-code is returned.
Done when the validation returns clean or the mandate is suspended.
verify: Read the validation response stored against the mandate.
Pass when the validation shows no return code before the first live draft.

steps.title: Set the draft date against the premium due date in BillingCenter
sop: Set the draft date so settlement lands on or before the premium due date.
Allow for the required ACH settlement days in the offset.
Confirm the calculated settlement date on a sample instalment.
Done when the draft date produces settlement on or before the due date.
verify: Recompute settlement date from draft date plus settlement days.
Pass when settlement date is on or before the premium due date.

steps.title: Configure the revocation path on the mandate in BillingCenter
sop: Confirm the revocation instructions given to the payor match the system path.
Configure the mandate so a revocation stops future drafts immediately.
Test a revocation on a non-production mandate and record the result.
Done when a revocation demonstrably stops future drafts.
verify: Read the revocation test result recorded on the case.
Pass when the tested revocation prevented the next scheduled draft.

steps.title: Activate the mandate on the billing account in BillingCenter
sop: Activate the mandate only after authorisation, validation and draft date are in place.
Confirm the account shows an active mandate with the correct start date.
Record the activation reference on the case.
Done when the mandate is active with a recorded reference.
verify: Read the mandate status and start date on the account.
Pass when the mandate is active with the authorised start date.

steps.title: Confirm the mandate appears in the next draft selection in BillingCenter
sop: Run the draft selection preview for the next scheduled run.
Confirm the new mandate is selected for the correct instalment and amount.
Correct any mismatch before the live run.
Done when the mandate appears correctly in the draft preview.
verify: Compare the previewed draft amount to the instalment due.
Pass when the previewed amount equals the instalment due for the account.

generic.Defined scope/population: Billing accounts with a requested change of payor for lienholder-pay or third-party-pay arrangements.
generic.In-scope period: Payor change requests received before the current cycle notice release.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Payor name, mailing address, remittance identifier, loan or account number and effective date are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of payor updates equals the count of verified change requests processed in the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The lienholder clause or signed authorisation is filed with a date and reference.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Requests without supporting authority are logged and rejected back to the requester.
generic.Test population: All payor record updates applied in BillingCenter during the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No payor record was overwritten without retaining the superseded values.
generic.Exception handling path: Unverified change requests are held and returned to the Policy Administration Analyst.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: New payor is effective-dated, the prior payor is end-dated and the next notice reflects the change.
generic.Evidence location: BillingCenter payor history and the authorisation document in the document management repository.

steps.title: Verify the change request against the authority document
sop: Compare the change request to the lienholder clause or signed insured authorisation.
Reject any request where the authority does not name the new payor.
Record the verification outcome on the change case.
Done when the request is verified against a filed authority document.
verify: Read the verification outcome and the linked document reference.
Pass when the authority document names the requested new payor.

steps.title: Confirm the loan or account number in the policy administration system
sop: Read the lienholder loan or account number recorded on the policy.
Compare it to the number on the change request.
Raise a query where the numbers differ.
Done when the loan or account number is confirmed or queried.
verify: Compare the confirmed number to the change request value.
Pass when the numbers agree or a query is logged.

steps.title: Update the payor name, address and remittance identifier in BillingCenter
sop: Enter the new payor name, mailing address and remittance identifier.
Enter the loan or account number from the lienholder document.
Save the update and capture the transaction reference.
Done when the account shows the new payor details.
verify: Compare the saved payor details to the authority document.
Pass when name, address and identifier match the document.

steps.title: End-date the prior payor record in BillingCenter
sop: End-date the prior payor rather than deleting the record.
Confirm historical notices remain linked to the prior payor.
Record the end date on the change case.
Done when the prior payor is end-dated and still traceable.
verify: Open the payor history on the account.
Pass when the prior payor appears with an end date and retained values.

steps.title: Decide re-issue of the current open notice in BillingCenter
sop: Check whether the current open notice has already been paid.
Re-issue to the new payor only where the notice remains unpaid.
Record the re-issue decision and reason on the case.
Done when a documented re-issue or no-re-issue decision exists.
verify: Compare the decision to the payment status of the open notice.
Pass when no paid notice was re-issued to the new payor.

steps.title: Confirm the change on the next generated premium notice in BillingCenter
sop: Generate the next premium notice for the account before the cycle releases.
Confirm the notice is addressed to the new payor with the correct identifier.
Attach the proof to the change case.
Done when the next notice shows the new payor details.
verify: Read the addressee and remittance block on the generated notice.
Pass when both match the updated payor record.

steps.title: File the authorisation and close the change case in the document management repository
sop: File the authority document and the notice proof as one evidence set.
Index the set by policy number and effective date.
Close the change case with the transaction reference recorded.
Done when the evidence set is filed and the case is closed.
verify: Retrieve the evidence set by policy number.
Pass when the set returns with the authority document and notice proof.

generic.Defined scope/population: Billing accounts to be validated against policy administration system premium for the same policies.
generic.In-scope period: Accounts with premium activity since the last validation, checked before the next notice run.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Written premium, total billing charges, tax and fee charge types and endorsement dates are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Policy written premium equals billing account total charges to the cent.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The validation comparison is recorded on the billing account with a date and preparer.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Endorsements without a matching billing adjustment are logged with a correction owner.
generic.Test population: All billing accounts with premium-affecting activity in the validation period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No endorsement exists in the policy system without a corresponding billing adjustment.
generic.Exception handling path: Out-of-sync accounts are held from the notice run until the adjustment is posted.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Premiums agree, charge types mirror, and the remaining schedule sums to the unbilled balance.
generic.Evidence location: The validation record on the BillingCenter account and the comparison sheet in Microsoft Excel.

steps.title: Extract policy written premium including endorsements from the policy administration system
sop: Extract written premium for the policy including all endorsements to date.
