Include taxes, fees and surcharges as separate amounts.
Record the extract date and the endorsement sequence covered.
Done when the policy premium extract exists with its component amounts.
verify: Compare the extract total to the policy premium summary screen.
Pass when the extract equals the policy premium summary.

steps.title: Extract billing account total charges from BillingCenter
sop: Extract total charges on the billing account by charge type.
Include premium, tax, fee and surcharge charge types separately.
Record the extract date to match the policy extract.
Done when the billing charge extract exists for the same date.
verify: Compare the billing extract date to the policy extract date.
Pass when both extracts are taken as at the same date.

steps.title: Compare policy premium to billing charges in Microsoft Excel
sop: Compare policy written premium to billing total charges to the cent.
List any account with a difference and quantify it.
Investigate differences before any notice is generated.
Done when the comparison shows agreement or an itemised difference list.
verify: Recompute the difference for each listed account.
Pass when every in-scope account shows zero difference after correction.

steps.title: Check tax, fee and surcharge mirroring by charge type in BillingCenter
sop: Compare each policy tax, fee and surcharge to the matching billing charge type.
Flag any amount folded into base premium on the billing side.
Correct the charge type mapping where mirroring fails.
Done when each policy component maps to its own billing charge type.
verify: List billing charge types and compare to policy components.
Pass when every policy component has its own matching billing charge type.

steps.title: Match the latest endorsement to a billing adjustment in BillingCenter
sop: Identify the most recent endorsement on the policy and its effective date.
Locate the matching billing adjustment transaction and compare effective dates.
Raise a correction where the adjustment is missing or misdated.
Done when the latest endorsement has a matching, correctly dated adjustment.
verify: Compare endorsement and adjustment effective dates.
Pass when the dates and amounts agree for the latest endorsement.

steps.title: Check the remaining instalment schedule against the unbilled balance in BillingCenter
sop: Sum the remaining instalments on the account schedule.
Compare the sum to the unbilled balance and check the final instalment for rounding drift.
Rebuild the schedule where drift exists.
Done when remaining instalments sum exactly to the unbilled balance.
verify: Recompute the instalment sum after any rebuild.
Pass when the sum equals the unbilled balance with no rounding residual.

steps.title: Record the validation result on the billing account in BillingCenter
sop: Record the validation outcome, date and preparer on the billing account.
Attach the comparison sheet reference to the record.
Release the account for the next notice generation run.
Done when the validation result is recorded before the notice run.
verify: Read the validation record and its date on the account.
Pass when the record predates the next notice generation run.

generic.Defined scope/population: Receipts that are less than the amount due on the billing account and must be applied as partial payments.
generic.In-scope period: Partial receipts captured in the current cash application day.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Instalment applied, applied amount, short-pay reason code and recalculated balance are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Applied amounts plus remaining balance equal the pre-payment account balance.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The remittance advice and the posting screen are retained against the receipt with a timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Shortfalls above tolerance are logged with the reason and the collections action taken.
generic.Test population: All partial premium receipts posted in BillingCenter for the day.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No partial payment remains unapplied on the account after posting.
generic.Exception handling path: Disputed short-pays are routed to the Billing Specialist before any lapse step advances.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Receipt is applied to named instalments with a reason code and a recalculated balance.
generic.Evidence location: BillingCenter receipt application history and the premium posting in the ERP general ledger.

steps.title: Read the remittance advice and identify the intended instalments
sop: Open the receipt and read any remittance advice or notice stub reference.
Note whether the payor directed the payment to a specific instalment.
Record the direction or its absence on the receipt.
Done when the payor direction is recorded or confirmed absent.
verify: Compare the recorded direction to the remittance document.
Pass when the recorded direction matches the remittance advice.

steps.title: Apply the receipt to the oldest open instalment in BillingCenter
sop: Apply the receipt against the oldest open instalment unless the advice directs otherwise.
Split the receipt across instalments where the amount spans more than one.
Save the application and capture the transaction reference.
Done when the full receipt is applied to named instalments.
verify: Sum the applied amounts and compare to the receipt amount.
Pass when the applied total equals the receipt with nothing unapplied.

steps.title: Confirm the fee and tax payment hierarchy in BillingCenter
sop: Check the documented payment hierarchy for fees, taxes and base premium.
Confirm the posting applied amounts in that documented order.
Reverse and repost where the hierarchy was not followed.
Done when the applied order matches the documented hierarchy.
verify: Read the applied component order on the posting.
Pass when fees and taxes were satisfied before base premium as documented.

steps.title: Recalculate the remaining balance and next amount due in BillingCenter
sop: Refresh the account and read the remaining balance and next amount due.
Compare them to the pre-payment balance less the applied amount.
Correct any account showing an inconsistent balance.
Done when the recalculated balance reconciles to the posting.
verify: Recompute balance as prior balance less applied amount.
Pass when the recomputed and displayed balances agree.

steps.title: Code the short-pay reason on the receipt in BillingCenter
sop: Select the short-pay reason code from partial remittance, disputed fee or omitted instalment fee.
Add a note where the reason is not covered by an existing code.
Save the code so aging reporting reflects the cause.
Done when every partial receipt carries a short-pay reason code.
verify: List partial receipts for the day and check the reason code field.
Pass when no partial receipt lacks a short-pay reason code.

steps.title: Test the shortfall against the de-minimis tolerance in BillingCenter
sop: Compare the residual shortfall to the de-minimis tolerance for the product.
Suppress the non-pay workflow where the shortfall is within tolerance.
Refer shortfalls above tolerance to the collections worklist.
Done when each shortfall is classified against the tolerance.
verify: Check the lapse queue for accounts inside tolerance.
Pass when no within-tolerance account entered the non-pay workflow.

steps.title: Confirm the premium posting reached the ERP general ledger
sop: Confirm the partial application produced a ledger entry in the ERP general ledger.
Check the entry hits cash and premium receivable per the posting map.
Investigate any receipt with no corresponding ledger entry.
Done when every partial application has a matching ledger entry.
verify: Compare the day total of partial applications to the ledger postings.
Pass when the two totals agree for the day.

generic.Defined scope/population: Captured premium receipts requiring matching and application to the correct policy or billing account.
generic.In-scope period: Receipts captured for the current cash application business day.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Match identifier, posted amount, receipt date, payment method and policy number are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Posted receipt totals equal the bank or lockbox record totals for the day.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The remittance stub image and the match evidence are retained against the receipt.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unmatched receipts are logged and routed to premium suspense with a research owner.
generic.Test population: All receipts matched and applied in BillingCenter during the day.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No receipt is posted on name similarity alone without an amount and reference match.
generic.Exception handling path: Uncertain matches route to premium suspense rather than being force-posted.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Every posted receipt carries a system match identifier and a receipt date equal to the bank date.
generic.Evidence location: BillingCenter receipt records and the premium paid-to-date update in the policy administration system.

steps.title: Match receipts on the notice stub reference in BillingCenter
sop: Read the policy number or remittance reference printed on the notice stub.
Match the receipt to the billing account using that reference.
Record the match identifier on the receipt.
Done when referenced receipts are matched to their billing accounts.
verify: Compare the matched account to the reference on the stub.
Pass when the matched account equals the account named by the reference.

steps.title: Match reference-less receipts on payor, amount and due date in BillingCenter
sop: For receipts with no reference, search on payor name plus exact amount plus due date.
Accept the match only when all three corroborate.
Record the corroborating fields on the receipt.
Done when each reference-less receipt is matched on three fields or left unmatched.
verify: Read the corroborating fields recorded on each such receipt.
Pass when every match records payor, amount and due date agreement.

steps.title: Route uncertain receipts to premium suspense in BillingCenter
sop: Move any receipt not matched with certainty to premium suspense.
Do not post to a close-name policy on similarity alone.
Assign a research owner and a follow-up date on the suspense item.
Done when every uncertain receipt sits in suspense with an owner.
verify: List posted receipts and check for name-similarity-only matches.
Pass when no receipt was posted on name similarity alone.

steps.title: Confirm posted amount, date and method against the bank record
sop: Compare the posted amount, receipt date and payment method to the bank or lockbox record.
Correct any posting that differs from the bank record.
Record the comparison on the daily application log.
Done when posted attributes equal the bank record for every receipt.
verify: Recompare a sample of postings to the bank record.
Pass when amount, date and method agree for every sampled receipt.

steps.title: Apply the matched receipts to the billing accounts in BillingCenter
sop: Apply each matched receipt to the open instalments on its account.
Confirm the account balance reduces by the applied amount.
Capture the application transaction reference on the receipt.
Done when every matched receipt is applied with a transaction reference.
verify: Compare applied totals to matched receipt totals.
Pass when the two totals agree with no unapplied matched receipt.

steps.title: Confirm premium paid-to-date in the policy administration system
sop: Run or await the posting interface to the policy administration system.
Confirm premium paid-to-date advanced for the affected policies.
Reprocess any policy the interface did not update.
Done when paid-to-date reflects the applied receipts.
verify: Compare paid-to-date on a sample of policies to the applied instalments.
Pass when paid-to-date matches the last instalment satisfied.

steps.title: Post the premium receipts to the ERP general ledger
sop: Confirm the applied receipts generated ledger entries in the ERP general ledger.
Check entries hit cash and premium receivable per the posting map.
Investigate and clear any interface reject the same day.
Done when every applied receipt has a ledger entry and no rejects remain.
verify: Compare the day application total to the ledger posting total.
Pass when the two totals agree and the reject queue is empty.

generic.Defined scope/population: All inbound premium receipt channels for the day: lockbox, ACH, card settlement, wire and portal.
generic.In-scope period: The current capture day covering all prior-day and same-day receipt files.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Receipt date, amount, payment method, payor name and source reference are populated on every receipt.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Loaded receipt count and dollar total per channel tie to the bank deposit advice.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Each loaded file and its control totals are retained with the load timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unreadable lockbox images and screening holds are logged with the same-day disposition.
generic.Test population: All receipt files loaded into BillingCenter for the capture day.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No prior-day receipt file remains unloaded at end of day.
generic.Exception handling path: Sanctioned-country or unexpected foreign remittances are held for screening before posting.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Every channel is loaded, reconciled to the bank advice and free of unresolved rejects.
generic.Evidence location: BillingCenter receipt register, the Payment Gateway settlement file and the ERP bank clearing account.

steps.title: Pull the lockbox and portal receipt files for the day
sop: Download the lockbox file and the portal payment extract for the capture day.
Record the file names, record counts and dollar totals.
Confirm no prior-day file remains undownloaded.
Done when all lockbox and portal files for the day are downloaded and counted.
verify: Compare downloaded file counts to the expected daily file schedule.
Pass when every expected file for the day is present.

steps.title: Pull ACH credits and card settlement from the Payment Gateway
sop: Download the ACH credit file and the card settlement file from the gateway.
Record record counts and dollar totals for each.
Note any settlement batch reported by the gateway but not received.
Done when gateway files are downloaded with control totals recorded.
verify: Compare gateway reported batch totals to the downloaded file totals.
Pass when the downloaded totals equal the gateway reported totals.

steps.title: Load each channel file into BillingCenter
sop: Load each channel file into the billing system as a receipt batch.
Confirm the loaded count and total match the file control totals.
Reject and reload any batch that fails validation.
Done when every channel file is loaded with matching control totals.
verify: Compare loaded batch totals to the source file totals.
Pass when loaded and source totals agree for every channel.

steps.title: Reconcile loaded receipts to the bank deposit advice
sop: Obtain the bank deposit advice for the day per channel.
Compare deposit counts and dollars to the loaded receipt totals.
List and chase any difference before day close.
Done when each channel ties to its deposit advice or the difference is listed.
verify: Recompute the per-channel difference against the deposit advice.
Pass when each channel difference is zero or fully explained.

steps.title: Check required receipt attributes are populated in BillingCenter
sop: Scan loaded receipts for missing date, amount, method, payor or source reference.
Complete missing attributes from the source file or image.
Reject receipts that cannot be completed to suspense research.
Done when every loaded receipt carries the five required attributes.
verify: Re-scan the loaded population for missing attributes.
Pass when no loaded receipt has a blank required attribute.

steps.title: Hold sanctioned-country and unexpected foreign remittances for screening
sop: Identify receipts routed from sanctioned countries or unexpected foreign remitters.
Place each on hold before posting and refer for screening.
Record the hold and referral reference on the receipt.
Done when every flagged receipt is held and referred.
verify: List posted receipts and check for flagged foreign routings.
Pass when no flagged receipt was posted before screening cleared.

steps.title: Re-key rejected lockbox images the same day in BillingCenter
sop: List lockbox items rejected as unreadable by the capture process.
Re-key each item from the stored image the same day.
Log any item that cannot be re-keyed with its disposition.
Done when no unreadable item is carried to the next cycle.
verify: Check the unreadable queue at day close.
Pass when the unreadable queue is empty or every item has a logged disposition.

steps.title: Confirm the day capture posted to the ERP general ledger
sop: Confirm receipt capture generated the expected ledger postings in the ERP.
Compare the ledger cash total to the day capture total.
Clear any interface reject before day close.
Done when the ledger reflects the full day capture.
verify: Compare ledger cash movement to the captured receipt total.
Pass when the two totals agree for the capture day.

generic.Defined scope/population: The self-service payment and auto-pay enrolment journey exposed to policyholders in the portal.
generic.In-scope period: The current release cycle in which the self-service capability is enabled or changed.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Mandate record, disclosed debit amount basis, draft date, cancel path and e-delivery flag are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Portal enrolment count equals the count of active mandates created in BillingCenter.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Test evidence for each scenario is retained with the release version and test date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Declined-card and failed-enrolment scenarios are logged with the observed system behaviour.
generic.Test population: All self-service payment and enrolment scenarios executed against the release.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No card or bank account number is returned to the browser or written to application logs.
generic.Exception handling path: Any scenario returning unmasked data blocks the release until remediated.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Enrolment creates an active mandate with disclosed amount and a working cancel path.
generic.Evidence location: The Customer Self-Service Portal test pack and the mandate records in BillingCenter.

steps.title: Confirm the portal payment page posts to the tokenising Payment Gateway
sop: Trace the portal payment submission to the gateway hosted endpoint.
Confirm the response returns only a token and masked last four digits.
Check application logs for any unmasked value.
Done when only tokens and masked values are observed end to end.
verify: Inspect the response payload and the application log entries.
Pass when no full card or account number appears in either.

steps.title: Check auto-pay disclosures on the enrolment screen in the portal
sop: Open the auto-pay enrolment screen as a policyholder.
Confirm it discloses the debit amount basis, the draft date and how to cancel.
Reject the release where any disclosure is missing.
Done when all three disclosures appear before the submit action.
verify: Re-read the enrolment screen against the disclosure checklist.
Pass when amount basis, draft date and cancel path are all shown.

steps.title: Test that enrolment writes an active mandate in BillingCenter
sop: Complete a test enrolment through the portal.
Confirm an active mandate appears on the billing account with the correct start date.
Confirm the paper premium notice is suppressed where e-delivery was elected.
Done when the test enrolment creates an active mandate and applies the notice preference.
verify: Read the mandate and notice preference on the test account.
Pass when the mandate is active and the notice preference matches the election.

steps.title: Test a declined card through the Payment Gateway
sop: Submit a test payment using a card the gateway will decline.
Confirm the policyholder sees a clear failure message.
Confirm the billing account is not marked paid.
Done when the decline is handled with a clear message and no payment posted.
verify: Read the account balance and payment history after the decline.
Pass when no payment was posted and the balance is unchanged.

steps.title: Test a same-day portal payment against dunning in BillingCenter
sop: Make a test portal payment on an account with a pending dunning step.
Confirm the balance updates the same day.
Confirm the pending dunning step is stopped.
Done when the payment updates the balance and halts dunning.
verify: Check the dunning queue for the test account after payment.
Pass when the account has left the pending dunning step.

steps.title: Assemble the self-service test pack for release
sop: Assemble evidence for tokenisation, disclosures, enrolment, decline and dunning tests.
Record the release version and the test date on the pack.
List any defect found with its severity.
Done when the pack covers all five scenarios with results.
verify: Review the pack against the scenario list.
Pass when every scenario has a recorded result and evidence.

steps.title: Approve the self-service capability for go-live
sop: Review the test pack and any open defect.
Block go-live where an unmasked data finding remains open.
Record the go-live approval with date and approver.
Done when the capability is approved or blocked with a recorded reason.
verify: Read the approval record and open defect list.
Pass when approval exists and no unmasked data defect is open.

generic.Defined scope/population: Receivable balances past the escalation threshold and candidate non-pay cancellations on the aging report.
generic.In-scope period: The current escalation cycle using the aging report as at the latest business date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Balance, days past due, dunning history, last contact date and recommended action are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Escalated account count plus excluded disputes equals the population past the threshold.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The aging extract and the escalation log are retained with the report date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Disputed and unapplied-cash accounts are logged as excluded with the reason.
generic.Test population: All accounts past the escalation threshold on the aging report.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No account with an open billing dispute is escalated as a non-pay cancellation candidate.
generic.Exception handling path: Disputes route to the Billing Operations Manager for resolution instead of collections escalation.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Every threshold account has a logged escalation with owner and recommended action.
generic.Evidence location: The BI reporting platform aging report and the escalation cases in the workflow tool.

steps.title: Run the aging report in the BI reporting platform
sop: Run the receivables aging report as at the latest business date.
Select balances past the escalation threshold or at the final dunning step.
Record the selected population count and value.
Done when the threshold population is selected and counted.
verify: Compare the selected value to the aged bucket totals on the report.
Pass when the selection reconciles to the aged bucket totals.

steps.title: Separate disputes and unapplied cash from non-pay candidates in BillingCenter
sop: Check each selected account for an open billing dispute or unapplied cash.
Remove those accounts from the non-pay candidate list.
Record the exclusion reason for each removed account.
Done when the candidate list contains only genuine non-pay accounts.
verify: Re-scan the candidate list for open disputes and unapplied cash.
Pass when no candidate carries an open dispute or unapplied cash.

steps.title: Attach dunning history and last contact date to each candidate in BillingCenter
sop: Pull the dunning step history and last contact attempt for each candidate.
Attach both to the escalation record.
Flag candidates with no recorded contact attempt.
Done when every candidate shows dunning history and last contact date.
verify: Scan candidates for missing contact history.
Pass when every candidate shows a dunning history and a contact date or a flag.

steps.title: Flag approaching statutory cancellation-notice dates in BillingCenter
sop: Calculate the statutory notice date for each candidate from the due date and state rule.
Flag candidates whose notice deadline falls inside the escalation cycle.
Prioritise flagged accounts at the top of the escalation pack.
Done when every candidate carries a notice deadline and priority flag.
verify: Compare flagged deadlines to the escalation cycle dates.
Pass when no notice deadline would pass unactioned inside the cycle.

steps.title: Log the escalation cases in the workflow tool
sop: Create an escalation case per candidate with balance, days past due and recommended action.
Assign an owner to each case.
Link the case to the aging report extract used.
Done when every candidate has a logged escalation case with an owner.
verify: Compare escalation case count to the candidate count.
Pass when every candidate has exactly one open escalation case.

steps.title: Review the escalation pack with collections management
sop: Review the escalation pack with the candidate list, exclusions and deadline flags.
Challenge any candidate lacking dunning or contact evidence.
Record the decisions on each escalation case.
Done when every case carries a management decision.
verify: Read the decision field on each escalation case.
Pass when no case remains without a recorded decision.

steps.title: Return disputes to billing for resolution in the workflow tool
sop: Route excluded dispute accounts to the billing dispute queue.
Set a resolution target date on each.
Confirm none re-enters the non-pay escalation while the dispute is open.
Done when every excluded dispute has an owner and a target date.
verify: Re-run the escalation selection after routing.
Pass when no open dispute account appears in the escalation population.

generic.Defined scope/population: Due instalments on accounts holding an active EFT or auto-pay mandate for the scheduled draft run.
generic.In-scope period: The draft run covering instalments due in the current settlement window.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Mandate token, instalment reference, draft amount, effective settlement date and run identifier are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Draft file record count and dollar total equal the instalments-due extract.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The draft file, control totals and bank acknowledgement are retained with the run timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Excluded mandates and file rejects are logged with the reason and next action.
generic.Test population: All instalments selected into the scheduled EFT draft run.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No instalment appears in two consecutive draft files.
generic.Exception handling path: Rejected records are corrected and drafted in the next run rather than manually re-keyed.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Balanced draft file transmitted with a retained bank acknowledgement and in-flight postings applied.
generic.Evidence location: BillingCenter draft run record, the Payment Gateway transmission log and the ERP general ledger.

steps.title: Select due instalments with active mandates in BillingCenter
sop: Select instalments due in the settlement window on accounts with an active mandate.
Exclude cancelled, lapsed and paid accounts from the selection.
Record the selected record count and dollar total.
Done when the selection excludes ineligible accounts and is counted.
verify: Re-scan the selection for cancelled, lapsed or paid accounts.
Pass when no ineligible account remains in the selection.

steps.title: Check the selection against the prior draft file in BillingCenter
sop: Compare the selected instalment references to the prior draft file.
Remove any instalment already drafted and still in flight.
Record the removed items with the reason.
Done when no instalment repeats from the prior draft file.
verify: Join current and prior selections on instalment reference.
Pass when the join returns no repeated instalment.

steps.title: Balance the draft file to the instalments-due extract in BillingCenter
sop: Produce the draft file and read its record count and dollar total.
Compare both to the instalments-due extract control totals.
Investigate any difference before transmitting.
Done when file and extract control totals agree.
verify: Recompute the file to extract difference.
Pass when the difference is zero for count and value.

steps.title: Confirm the settlement date honours pre-notification and lead time
sop: Read the effective settlement date on the draft file header.
Confirm it honours pre-notification periods for newly added mandates.
Confirm it honours the required lead time before the due date.
Done when the settlement date satisfies both rules.
verify: Recompute the settlement date against the rules for a sample of records.
Pass when every sampled record satisfies pre-notification and lead time.

steps.title: Transmit the draft file through the Payment Gateway
sop: Transmit the balanced draft file to the bank through the gateway.
Capture the transmission reference and time.
Retry once on transmission failure and escalate if it fails again.
Done when the file is transmitted with a captured reference.
verify: Read the transmission log entry for the run.
Pass when the log shows a successful transmission with a reference.

steps.title: File the bank acknowledgement against the run in BillingCenter
sop: Retrieve the bank acknowledgement or receipt for the transmitted file.
Compare the acknowledged count and total to the transmitted file.
File the acknowledgement against the draft run record.
Done when the acknowledgement is filed and matches the file totals.
verify: Compare acknowledged totals to transmitted totals.
Pass when the acknowledged count and value equal the transmitted file.

steps.title: Post pending drafts as in-flight in BillingCenter
sop: Post the transmitted drafts to the accounts as in-flight payments.
Confirm the affected instalments are no longer selectable by the next run.
Record the in-flight posting reference on the run.
Done when all transmitted drafts are posted as in-flight.
verify: Run the next draft selection preview.
Pass when no in-flight instalment appears in the next selection.

steps.title: Approve the completed draft run
sop: Review the control totals, acknowledgement and in-flight postings.
Approve the run as complete or raise an exception.
Record the approval name and timestamp on the run.
Done when the run carries a dated approval or a raised exception.
verify: Read the approval record on the draft run.
Pass when the run shows a dated manager approval.

generic.Defined scope/population: All premium payment transactions posted to the payment ledger for the business day.
generic.In-scope period: The current accounting day, with late items posted to the current open period.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Date, amount, payment source, policy reference, transaction ID and posting operator are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Day total of ledger postings equals the day total of captured receipts.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The ledger posting report is retained with the accounting date and run timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Late items and corrections are logged with the reason and the offsetting reference.
generic.Test population: All payment ledger entries posted for the accounting day.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No ledger entry is dated into a closed accounting period.
generic.Exception handling path: Rejected postings are corrected and reposted with a documented reason rather than adjusted in place.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Entries carry all required attributes, a unique transaction ID and reconcile to captured receipts.
generic.Evidence location: The ERP general ledger posting report and the BillingCenter receipt register for the day.

steps.title: Extract the day receipt register from BillingCenter
sop: Extract all captured receipts for the accounting day.
Record the count and dollar total by payment source.
Note the extraction timestamp on the daily log.
Done when the receipt register extract exists with control totals.
verify: Compare the extract total to the daily capture report.
Pass when both totals agree for the day.

steps.title: Confirm required attributes on each ledger entry in the ERP general ledger
sop: Open the day ledger postings for premium receipts.
Confirm each carries date, amount, source, policy reference and posting operator or batch.
List entries missing any attribute for correction.
Done when every entry carries the five attributes or is listed.
verify: Re-scan the postings for missing attributes.
Pass when no posted entry has a blank required attribute.

steps.title: Check GL account mapping against the posting map
sop: Compare the accounts hit by premium receipts to the documented posting map.
Confirm cash, premium receivable and suspense are used as mapped.
Raise a correction for any mis-mapped entry.
Done when every entry maps to the documented accounts.
verify: Sample entries across sources and check account codes.
Pass when every sampled entry hits the mapped accounts.

steps.title: Reconcile ledger postings to captured receipts
sop: Compare the day total of ledger postings to the day total of captured receipts.
Identify receipts with no posting and postings with no receipt.
Clear every difference before day close.
Done when postings and receipts agree for the day.
verify: Recompute the posting to receipt difference.
Pass when the difference is zero at day close.

steps.title: Check for entries dated into a closed period in the ERP general ledger
sop: Scan the day postings for effective dates in a closed accounting period.
Repost any such item into the current open period with a reason.
Record the late-item reason on the posting.
Done when no posting carries a closed-period date.
verify: Re-scan postings for closed-period dates.
Pass when no entry is dated into a closed accounting period.

steps.title: Confirm corrections post as reversal plus new entry in the ERP general ledger
sop: List corrections made during the day.
Confirm each appears as an offsetting reversal plus a new entry.
Confirm the original reference is retained on both legs.
Done when every correction is a reversal plus re-entry with the original reference.
verify: Trace each correction to its reversal and re-entry.
Pass when no correction was made by editing an original entry.

steps.title: Confirm unique transaction IDs across the day ledger
sop: Extract transaction IDs for all day postings.
Test for duplicates across sources and batches.
Investigate and correct any duplicate before close.
Done when every posting carries a unique transaction ID.
verify: Run a duplicate test on the transaction ID list.
Pass when the duplicate test returns no rows.

generic.Defined scope/population: Unscheduled flexible premium payments received on universal life and annuity contracts.
generic.In-scope period: Payments received in good order during the current processing day.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Contract number, deposit amount, good-order receipt date, allocation split and limit test result are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Allocated amounts total 100 percent of the applied deposit across elected options.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The limit test output and allocation instruction are retained against the deposit transaction.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Payments breaching a maximum premium or tax limit are quarantined with the decision recorded.
generic.Test population: All flexible premium payments processed for the day.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No flexible premium was applied that breaches a contractual maximum or tax-qualification limit.
generic.Exception handling path: Quarantined deposits are referred to the Policy Administration Analyst before application or return.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Deposit posts on the good-order date with a compliant allocation and a retained limit test.
generic.Evidence location: The contract transaction history in the policy administration system and the ERP premium posting.

steps.title: Confirm the contract permits an unscheduled premium in the policy administration system
sop: Open the contract and confirm it allows flexible or unscheduled premium.
Confirm the contract is in force and not in a restricted status.
Record the eligibility confirmation on the deposit case.
Done when contract eligibility for the deposit is confirmed.
verify: Read the contract status and flexible premium indicator.
Pass when the contract is in force and permits unscheduled premium.

steps.title: Establish the good-order receipt date on the deposit
sop: Determine the date the payment and complete instructions were received in good order.
Record that date as the crediting date on the deposit.
Do not use the processing date where it differs from good order receipt.
Done when the good-order receipt date is recorded on the deposit.
verify: Compare the recorded date to the receipt and instruction timestamps.
Pass when the recorded date equals the good-order receipt date.

steps.title: Run the maximum premium and tax limit tests in the policy administration system
sop: Test the deposit against the contractual maximum premium.
Run the guideline premium and seven-pay tests where applicable.
Quarantine the deposit where any test fails.
Done when every test result is recorded against the deposit.
verify: Read the retained limit test outputs on the deposit.
Pass when all tests pass or the deposit is quarantined.

steps.title: Confirm the allocation instructions total 100 percent
sop: Read the owner allocation instructions of record for the contract.
Confirm the split percentages total exactly 100 percent.
Query the owner where the instructions are incomplete or stale.
Done when a valid allocation totalling 100 percent is confirmed.
verify: Sum the allocation percentages on the deposit.
Pass when the percentages total exactly 100 percent.

steps.title: Apply the deposit at the crediting date values in the policy administration system
sop: Apply the deposit using the unit values or crediting parameters for the good-order date.
Confirm each option receives its allocated share.
Capture the transaction reference on the deposit case.
Done when the deposit is applied at the correct date values.
verify: Compare the unit values used to the good-order date values.
Pass when the applied values match the good-order date.

steps.title: Confirm updated accumulation value and cost basis on the contract
sop: Read the accumulation value and cost basis after the deposit.
Confirm the movement equals the applied deposit plus crediting.
Correct any contract where the values do not reconcile.
Done when accumulation value and cost basis reflect the deposit.
verify: Recompute the accumulation value movement from the deposit.
Pass when the recomputed and displayed movements agree.

steps.title: Reconcile the deposit to the cash receipt in the ERP general ledger
sop: Match the applied contract deposit to the corresponding cash receipt.
Confirm the ledger premium posting equals the applied deposit.
Investigate any deposit without matching cash.
Done when every deposit ties to a cash receipt and a ledger posting.
verify: Compare deposit totals to ledger premium postings for the day.
Pass when the two totals agree for the day.

steps.title: Release the owner confirmation for the deposit
sop: Confirm the deposit, allocation and updated values are correct on the contract.
Release the confirmation to the owner through the standard channel.
Record the confirmation reference on the deposit case.
Done when the confirmation is released with a recorded reference.
verify: Read the confirmation content against the applied deposit.
Pass when the confirmation shows the correct amount, date and allocation.
